heading: Capabilities
genericConsequence: This capability is enabled but not working.
failingConsequence: The last run did not complete.

overdueConsequence.notCompleting: No successful run within {{hours}} hours. The nightly job is not completing.
overdueConsequence.neverCompleted: No successful run within {{hours}} hours. The job has never completed.

redaction.name: Redaction
redaction.description: Pseudonymizes names and other sensitive entities on this machine before any text reaches the model provider.
redaction.consequence: Redaction is enabled but the service is unreachable: model calls will fail rather than send unredacted content.

research.name: Web research
research.description: Searches the public web from this instance and reads approved pages into memory. You see the query before it leaves.
research.consequence: Research is unavailable until the search service is reachable.

mail.name: Email capture
mail.description: Receives forwarded mail at this instance’s inbound address and captures it, routed by sender. Off means no SMTP listener runs at all.
mail.consequence: Email capture is enabled but the inbound mail service is not answering: forwarded mail is not being received.

demo.name: Demo sandbox
demo.description: Seeds the fictional demo workspace and serves a shared demo session. Never for an instance holding real data.
demo.consequence: Demo mode is set on a production instance: the guard refuses to seed. An operator must unset one of the two flags.

consoles.name: Infra consoles
consoles.description: Operator-only MinIO and Qdrant consoles, served on this machine at localhost port 8443.
consoles.consequence: The consoles are enabled but not answering.

local-models.name: Local models
local-models.description: Runs model work on a local Ollama runtime instead of a hosted provider, so content stays on your hardware.
local-models.consequence: The local model runtime is unreachable: model features on local tiers fail until it is back.

vision.name: Reading pictures
vision.description: Reads pages that are images: scans, photographs, drawings and schematics. Cheapest first, so a page with real text is never sent to a model. Off means those pages are labelled unreadable instead of silently empty.
vision.consequence: Vision is configured but not answering: pages that are pictures cannot be read, and they are labelled as needing it rather than shown as processed. If the message mentions a timeout, the endpoint may simply be warming up rather than broken.

dreaming.name: Nightly dreaming
dreaming.description: Consolidates the day’s memories: duplicates merge, contradictions surface, stale facts age out.

sweep.name: Receipt sweep
sweep.description: Verifies every deletion receipt against the stores each night, so forgetting stays provable.
